title: A Borodin-Okounkov-Geronimo-Case identity for tilted Toeplitz minors
publication_status: Verified preprint manifestation; no journal manifestation established in this check
source_locator: PDF pp. 1–3 (§§1.1–1.3); p. 8 (2.6); pp. 9–11 (3.3)–(3.8), Theorem 3.1; pp. 13–16 (4.2)–(4.11), Theorem 4.4, Propositions 4.6–4.7; supplementary spot checks of §5 and Appendix A
read_scope: Scoped comparison of the Hardy-space splitting, Gram-invertibility and graph-chart hypotheses, their determinant identities, and applicability of the analytic polynomial row and column tilts. Not a complete reading.
main_result: A tilted Toeplitz minor factors into a Szegő factor, a finite Gram determinant, and a Fredholm determinant on an oblique complementary space. Under additional graph-chart invertibility a canonical-tail form is available, with a bounded-rank kernel correction for bounded-degree polynomial tilts.
result_status: Source statements and role in proposed proof dependency checked in cited passages. No whole-work audit, novelty conclusion, or arithmetic transfer.
selection_reason: The exact general tilted identity applies to the finite circular Jacobi numerator for the derivative-rooted CUE statistic. This is a direct alternate proof interface and supports the exact Gram versus complementary-series comparison.
transfer_hypothesis: At fixed N the symbol is the nonvanishing exponential of a finite Laurent polynomial, and the row and column polynomial tilts have degree J. The Gram is invertible near zero and on the real Laplace axis by the matched adjoint structure. The optional fixed-tail graph chart has a separate invertibility condition.
